name: Cave painting
description: Prehistoric rock art: bison, horses, deer, hunters and hand stencils in ochre, red and charcoal on cave walls and rock shelters.
light: warm flickering firelight or soft shade under a rock overhang
cool grey daylight entering from a cave mouth
a single torch beam on one part of the wall, deep darkness around
warm low sun on an open rock shelter
composition: animals spread across the natural bumps of the rock, overlapping, no ground line; or a wide rock shelter in landscape
one large animal filling the wall, close and detailed
a long frieze of animals moving in one direction
a wide view of a rock shelter in the landscape, paintings small on the wall
camera_or_medium: mineral pigment and charcoal on limestone, photographed close
texture_detail: rough stone, cracks and mineral stains, blown-pigment edges, faded layers
subjects: a herd of horses running across a cave wall
hand stencils around a red bison
a rock shelter at dusk with painted figures
